name: Text Field Formatter
description: This is the extension of the plain text field formatter with additional wrappers, classes and attributes.
project_description:
This module is the extension of the plain text formatter. 

 The module features: 

 
 Ability to add an additional wrapper to the text field. 
 Ability to add classes to this wrapper. 
 Ability to add any of the attributes to this wrapper. 
 The option for overriding a link label (tokens are supported). 
 
 Compatible with Layout Builder - the easiest way to add an H1 tag to the node title on the page. 

Compatible with the Linked field .

 The idea behind this module is taken from another similar module: String field formatter 

 But they have a difference:

The String field formatter is an independent formatter but this module extended the plain text formatter from the Drupal core and inherit options like this - "Link to the Content" checkbox.
